scope: Deployed runtime, bounded real cloud reads, one new cloud bundle, offline provider samples, official emulators and isolated recovery. These scopes remain distinct.

earlierRun.cause: New source-preview tests asserted before their real GET/toggle completed; both tests corrected and repeated before full green CI.

resolvedIssues: Cloud Tasks named dispatch deduplication and confirmed tombstone recovery preserve one job and charge.
One per-Domain quota-reservation transaction avoids counter contention at current two-instance bound.
Verified account admission precedes queued image body reads, including unfinished chunked bodies.
Version-pinned single-flight catalog loading and bounded query cache preserve product identity checks.
Literal source typography handling recovers sources without rewriting original chunks or citations.
Generated lessons and indexed correct quiz options cannot add recognized new conditions to original unconditional prohibitions; known unsafe stored results require regeneration.
Auth restore excludes the password pseudo-provider while retaining original password hashes.
Recovery jobs import a library without the CLI entry side effect.
Restore excludes expired uploads and owners lacking current Auth/account deletion-guard evidence.
Valid saved chat treatment context such as bare 使用時 is retained; earlier nested symptom thresholds remain checked instead of being hidden by the treatment phrase.
Saved chat medication identity distinguishes loading and read failures from a successfully read list with a genuinely absent medication.

Manual/search creation retries reuse an owner-scoped operation and immutable canonical input fingerprint; they neither duplicate nor overwrite edited/archived records or invalidate later learning/reminders.
A delayed explanation read, background progress, error or completion cannot replace content after medication editing/removal or clear a newer request state.
Device registration, removal and deleted-account cleanup transactionally recheck current account state and device ownership.

Origin-wide push coordination spans actual provider and owner HTTP operations; an outgoing session cannot revoke another page token, pending committed registrations remain addressable, and failed unlink has a tested recovery path.

objectiveReview.scope: Independent adversarial source review and targeted actual-component local browser tests, followed by root combined local regression. Exact-commit CI/deployment are recorded separately.

confirmedBugs.baseline: A committed manual/search POST followed by a lost response could create another medication on retry.
confirmedBugs.fix: Owner-scoped deterministic creation key plus immutable schema-canonical payload hash on the original medication; matching receipt returns unchanged revision, changed payload or edited/archived record conflicts.
confirmedBugs.extraAdversarialCase: Retake-and-resume originally remounted the form with a different key. The key is now retained with the paused review.

confirmedBugs.baseline: A delayed saved-learning read could render old content after the medication had been edited or removed.
confirmedBugs.fix: Request generation invalidates on edit/remove/save/unmount. All async reads, progress, errors and final busy cleanup are guarded by the current generation.

confirmedBugs.baseline: Registration authorized before account deletion could write a device after cleanup; stale deletion could also remove a transferred device.
confirmedBugs.fix: Registration and removal recheck account state and ownership in Firestore transactions. Account cleanup rechecks the current device owner before deletion.
confirmedBugs.transactionOrdering: All added transaction reads occur before writes; registration reads the account document and therefore conflicts with deletion state changes.

confirmedBugs.baseline: An old logout could revoke browser-wide FCM after a new session enabled push. An actual two-page same-origin AuthProvider probe also reproduced another still-signed-in page losing FCM after the old owner unlink returned 404.
confirmedBugs.fix: Origin-wide Web Locks span actual provider and native HTTP completion, independently of shorter UI deadlines. Owner mismatch 404 never revokes the shared provider token. Pending device SHA-256 is retained before POST, intentional signOut null callbacks do not invalidate cleanup, and late or unsupported coordination is explicitly rejected while ordinary login/logout remains available.

targetedTests.realProviderBoundary: AuthProvider probes run real application components with local synthetic Firebase/FCM boundaries. They do not prove actual FCM delivery or Android background notifications.

additionalLimits: Synthetic provider and HTTP boundaries cannot establish actual FCM delivery, Android background delivery or real Google signOut timing beyond the reproduced observer contract.

No new paid AI, mobile camera, or large-scale live-provider capacity test was performed by this review.
